preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The integer K is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(97 <= ord(c) <= 122 for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are lowercase Latin characters.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no substring with exactly K distinct characters, otherwise it is the length of the longest such substring.
